title: My Town
description: Practise there is/are, has got and can, and write a short description of your town.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There ___ some nice cafes in the town centre.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are some nice cafes.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: There ___ (not / be) a cinema in my town.
answers: isn't
is not
exercises.explanation: The negative of "there is" is "there isn't" (there is not): there isn't a cinema.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My town has got a river.
exercises.explanation: Subject + has got + noun: My town has got a river.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My town have got a big park.
answers: My town has got a big park.
My town's got a big park.
My town has a big park.
exercises.explanation: My town = it, so use "has got": my town has got.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best word to join the ideas.
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two ideas that are a little different: small, but beautiful.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with can or can't.
exercises.text: You ___ swim in the river. It is dangerous.
answers: can't
cannot
can not
exercises.explanation: Use "can't" (cannot) to say something is not possible or not allowed: you can't swim.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: The bank is ___ the post office.
exercises.explanation: Use "next to" for something beside another thing: next to the post office.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are two big librarys in my town.
answers: There are two big libraries in my town.
exercises.explanation: Nouns ending in consonant + y change y to -ies: library, libraries.

exercises.prompt: Write a or an.
exercises.text: There is ___ old castle on the hill.
answers: an
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an old castle.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like walking in the park.
In the park I like walking.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: I like walking.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: The people in my town ___ very friendly.
exercises.explanation: "People" is plural, so use "are": the people are.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: You can buys fresh fruit at the market.
answers: You can buy fresh fruit at the market.
exercises.explanation: After "can", use the base form of the verb (no -s): you can buy.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My town is near the sea, ___ there are lots of boats.
exercises.explanation: Use "so" to give a result.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: The bus ___ (go) to the city centre every ten minutes.
answers: goes
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, "go" becomes "goes".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: There is a park near my house.
Near my house there is a park.
Is there a park near my house?
exercises.explanation: There is + a singular noun + place: There is a park near my house.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: The shops close on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with days of the week: on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Our town is famous for ___ old bridge.
exercises.explanation: Use "its" (no apostrophe) for something that belongs to a thing: its bridge. "It's" means "it is".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Does your town has a museum?
answers: Does your town have a museum?
exercises.explanation: After "does" in a question, use the base form of the verb: Does it have ...?

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I live in a small town.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with towns and cities: I live in a small town.

exercises.prompt: Write the negative form of have.
exercises.text: My town ___ (not / have) got a zoo.
answers: hasn't
has not
exercises.explanation: Use "hasn't got" (has not got) with he, she and it: my town hasn't got a zoo.

task.prompt: Write about your town or city.
contentPoints: Say the name of your town and where it is.
Say what there is in your town.
Say what people can do there.
Say if you like your town and why.
task.modelAnswer: I live in Hoi An. It is a small town near the sea. There are lots of old houses, cafes and a market. You can ride a bike or go to the beach. I like my town because it is quiet and beautiful.
